items.description: Classify learnings into memory, skills, or project records. Keeps global agent context compact by deciding whether feedback, an incident, or a solution belongs as durable user memory, a reusable skill, or repo-scoped project knowledge — without duplicating detail across all three.

items.description: Prove behavior before declaring engineering work complete. A green command, static review, or agent summary is not proof unless it exercises the claimed behavior at a real seam — mounted component, CLI invocation, API call, or end-to-end flow.
